mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.4% compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as capital costs decline.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.4% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE increases > 0.5pp over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicate broad-based economic contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and INDPRO fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 5.0%) triggers aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations for negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY inflation exceeds 5.0% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Residential construction activity (HOUST) above 1100 thousand units signals strong consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days through earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1100 thousand units.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 105.0 index level indicates manufacturing weakness, reducing corporate output and triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO is below 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: Strong consumer demand (RSAFS > 450,000 million) combined with low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.4%) creates an accommodative environment that fuels positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of RSAFS > 450000 and FEDFUNDS < 0.4% fails to yield positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Tight labor market conditions (UNRATE < 4.0%) generate wage pressures and inflation, prompting Fed rate hikes that reduce equity valuations for negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE is below 4.0% over a 3-year rolling window.
